description: access_groups.listAccessGroups (GET /v1/access-groups) models its 200 body as oneOf([{type:'object'}, {accessGroups,pagination}]). The bare untyped first arm collapses the generated union to unknown, making the typed accessGroups/pagination shape unreachable (ListAccessGroupsResponse = unknown). Promote the real second arm to be the schema so the provider's list/enumeration path gets the typed collection without casts.
